items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: I know Red, well Red didn't want to play.

ctx.x: Well, Dick, the last time I saw Dick has been a couple of years, but then I've seen Dick. And he's probably still as skinny as ever. And, but Dick went along to play with some out of town bands. Dick was well thought of as a trumpet player. And, but he didn't want to play professionally on here. That's the story that I got. I don't know that, and I know Red, well Red didn't want to play. Red wanted to be a big shot. He wanted to hang around the stock market and see what that is.
Were anybody in your family musicals, anybody? Besides you?
